content:

title: ⬆️ Level Upgrade Subsidy Activities
summary: Upgrade to VIP level and get additional subsidies
content:
📋 Activity Rules:

  1. When users upgrade from Junior Employee to VIP 1 or above, the company will provide additional subsidies.

  3. On the day of the upgrade, users can immediately start using the new level's features and order operations.

🎁 Reward Details:

  • Upgrade to VIP 1 or above → Additional subsidy of 600 ETB

📅 Activity Period: August 17 to August 23, 2026

title: 💰 Fixed Salary and Tax Subsidy
summary: Receive a fixed salary based on the number of VIP members in your team
content:
📋 Activity Rules:

  • A fixed salary is distributed once a month on the 1st day (UTC).
  • After meeting the tax subsidy criteria, you can request the subsidy fund during each successful cash-out period.
  • This benefit is permanent – the more members you have, the higher your salary payment will be.
  • Only VIP-level members within the team are counted.

title: 🎟️ 50 ETB VIP2 Level Upgrade Lottery Event
summary: 480 tickets — 1 lucky winner receives VIP2 level upgrade
time: Starts upon launch until all 480 tickets are sold (draw at 15:00 UTC the next day)
content:
📜 50 ETB VIP2 Level Upgrade Lottery Event Rules

Article 1: Event Overview

This is a paid lottery event with each ticket priced at 50 ETB. There are a total of 480 tickets available. From these, 1 lucky winner will receive a VIP2 level upgrade (can be used for themselves or gifted to another person). 🎁

Article 2: Participation Rules

  1. Entry Price: Each ticket costs 50 ETB. Multiple tickets can be purchased — more tickets mean a higher winning probability.
  2. Entry Method: After payment is completed, the system assigns unique participation numbers in order of transaction time. 🔢
  3. Participation Limit: A total of 480 tickets are available. The event ends once all tickets are sold out. Each user may purchase any quantity without a maximum limit.
  4. Eligibility Confirmation: Once payment is completed and verified by the system, the user qualifies for participation. ✅

Article 3: Prize Pool & Winner Selection System

  • Prize: 1 VIP2 level upgrade qualification (not exchangeable for cash). 🏆
  • Number of Winners: Only 1 winner.
  • Winning Probability: Proportional to the number of participation numbers held.
  • Drawing Mechanism: The system randomly selects the winner — fair and impartial. 🤖

Article 4: Draw & Results Announcement

  1. Draw Time: After all 480 tickets are completely sold out, the draw will take place the next day at 15:00 (UTC). ⏰
  2. Results Announcement: The winning result will be published within 1 hour after the draw. The winner's order number and username (partially masked) will be disclosed. 📢
  3. Prize Distribution: Within 24 hours after the results are announced, the winner will be notified and guided through the necessary steps. 💸

Article 5: Important Notices

  1. No Refunds: Once payment is verified, the 50 ETB is non-refundable.
  2. VIP1 Deposit: The winner's existing VIP1 deposit will not be returned; it will automatically convert to a VIP2 performance bond.
  3. VIP2 and Above: No deposit is required. The qualification can be gifted to others.
  4. Gifting Rules: The winner may gift the qualification to another person for free (limited to one time). The recipient must have a working account. The winner must register with the Recruitment Manager within 24 hours after the results are announced. Failure to do so will result in forfeiture of the qualification.
  5. Violations: Cheating or any other improper behavior will result in disqualification and appropriate action will be taken. 🚫
  6. Interpretation Rights: The platform reserves the final right of interpretation. Any changes will be announced separately.

Note: Participating in this event constitutes full agreement to all of the above rules. 🤝
